additions.distinctness_review: Screened all 415 current sites, 441 projects, source records and identity mappings across NSCC, National Supercomputing, Shenzhen supercomputing, Guangming and Chinese/LineShine aliases; no match. Held-source broad Guangming hits concern unrelated Hohhot/Wujiang sources. Nearest existing campus is Boda Qianhai, about30.59km away; this is a separate operator and property.

locator.identity_review: Operator overview places LineShine at Guangming Phase 2, distinct from Xili Phase 1. Its contact page links the named Phase 2 Amap POI, but no unconverted map coordinate or viewport is selected. Historical municipal permit GM-2023-0020 names the same supercomputing upgrade project at plot 01-06/A649-0643; the exact web-tool extraction is pinned and explicitly distinguished from origin PDF bytes. The captured official plot map matches WGS84 Esri imagery by the highway crossing, western warehouse compound, southwest loop junction, trapezoidal site and eastern reservoir context. Root independently reviewed this match and the point lies inside the identified parent property.
locator.precision: Approximate analyst-selected point inside the identified Guangming Phase 2 parent campus, rounded to four decimal places. Not an operator-published pin, surveyed centroid, cadastral boundary, server-room footprint or marker for the whole Guangming Science City.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Official map and Esri imagery acquisition dates and absolute positional accuracies are unknown. Manual map matching, historic change and parallax introduce unquantified uncertainty. Pixel resolution and displayed decimal places do not bound ground accuracy.
